description: This file defines functions for creating various list components used in a text-based user interface, such as select lists, searchable select lists, filterable select lists, and settings lists. It imports types and components from external modules and themes, and exports factory functions to instantiate these UI components with specified options.

methods.name: export function createSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSelectList
methods.description: Creates an instance of SelectList with provided items and theme, with an optional maximum visible items parameter.

methods.name: export function createSearchableSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSearchableSelectList
methods.description: Creates an instance of SearchableSelectList with provided items and theme, with an optional maximum visible items parameter.

methods.name: export function createFilterableSelectList(items: FilterableSelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createFilterableSelectList
methods.description: Creates an instance of FilterableSelectList with provided items and theme, with an optional maximum visible items parameter.

methods.name: export function createSettingsList( createSettingsList
methods.description: Creates an instance of SettingsList with provided items, event handlers, theme, and optional maximum visible items.

ctags.name: SelectItem
ctags.pattern: /^import { type SelectItem, SelectList, type SettingItem, SettingsList } from "@mariozechner\/pi-t/
